items.title: Coor förvärvar norsk facility management-koncern och stärker ytterligare sin position i Norden
items.summary: Coor förvärvar norsk facility management-koncern och stärker ytterligare sin position i Norden 2026-11-19 08:00:00 Coor Service Management Holding AB ("Coor") har ingått ett avtal om förvärv av en väletablerad norsk facility management-koncern bestående av fyra fristående bolag (tillsammans benämnda "Insider Group") ("Transaktionen"). Insider Group erbjuder tjänster inom lokalvård, fastighetsservice och mat och dryck, samt tjänster inom tillfälliga personalboenden ("camps"). Transaktionen kommer att skapa en rikstäckande närvaro i Norge, en breddad kundbas, stärkta positioner inom lokalvård och fastighetsservice samt förbättrad konkurrenskraf

items.title: Coor signs agreement with Norwegian property company Entra
items.summary: Coor signs agreement with Norwegian property company Entra 2026-11-10 08:00:00 Following an extensive tender process, Entra has selected Coor in Norway as its service provider for cleaning, catering and reception services at around 40 properties in Oslo, Bergen and Sandvika. The contract runs for three years, with an option to extend, and has an annual value of approximately SEK 275 million. Work is due to commence in Q2 2027, and this is one of the year's largest IFM contracts in Norway. items.title: Coor extends IFM agreement with ABB and ABB Robotics
items.summary: Coor extends IFM agreement with ABB and ABB Robotics 2026-10-08 09:00:00 Coor has extended its agreement with ABB and ABB Robotics regarding the delivery of a range of FM services to ABB and ABB Robotics in Sweden. The new contract spans three years with an option to extend it for a further two. The annual contract value amounts to approximately SEK 150 million for Sweden, Norway, Estonia and Lithuania. ABB has renewed its agreement with Coor regarding the coordination, delivery and development of a wide range of FM services for ABB's and ABB Robotics' offices and production facilities in Sweden, Norway, Estonia and Lithuania.
